messages:
owen: quick check — I need to run a weekly connectivity probe from prod analytics -> partner SFTP (sftp.partner.com). Partner provided two IPs, want to confirm best pattern: add temp egress allowlist on prod NAT or request partner VPCE/peering? Also want to confirm logging/redaction expectations for flow logs.

maya: prefer VPCE or partner-side allowlist if possible. If we must open egress from our VPC, make it temporary and scoped to a single SG rule & route through a dedicated nat/bastion pool. For flow logs, we redact/limit in public audit copies — full logs go to restricted S3 with kms & tighter IAM.

samir: approval/process notes: we need a short justification, owner, expiry (max 24h for probes), and a PR in infra repo that creates the rule + tags. I'll approve if JIRA ticket + PR exist. Also: do NOT embed long-lived keys in the probe — use STS assume-role with short-lived creds.

owen: details: IPs are 18.205.33.5 and 18.205.33.6 (partner claim). Probe uses service account analytics-probe. Port 22. Plan was to add temporary egress to prod SG and remove after 24h. Any red flags?

claire: ping security: @maya any policy against storing third-party IPs in allowlist? We usually avoid persistently storing vendors in global allowlists.

maya: policy: short-lived allowlists OK for scheduled probes. If we create allowlist entry, tag with `temp-egress`, `owner:owen`, `expiry:YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MMZ`. Add automation to revoke. For logs, do NOT include sourcePrivateIp in public dashboards for third-party connections. Keep minimal connection metadata where possible.

security-bot: Reminder — for any third-party IP changes, create an approval artifact: /approvals/infra and include link to JIRA. Compliance will pick up.

owen: I'll open INFRA ticket and a PR. Command I'm planning to run (once PR+approval exists):

```
aws ec2 authorize-security-group-egress --group-id sg-0a1b2c3d4e --protocol tcp --port 22 --cidr 18.205.33.5/32
aws ec2 authorize-security-group-egress --group-id sg-0a1b2c3d4e --protocol tcp --port 22 --cidr 18.205.33.6/32
```

maya: do NOT execute any CLI changes before PR merged and @samir approval. Also include the revoke commands in the PR or a scheduled job: revoke after 24h. Example revoke: 

```
aws ec2 revoke-security-group-egress --group-id sg-0a1b2c3d4e --protocol tcp --port 22 --cidr 18.205.33.5/32
```

samir: also add a short runbook snippet in the PR describing: why, owner, expected traffic, verification steps (tcp handshake logs ok), and rollback steps. I'll +1 then.

claire: :thumbsup: please add me to the JIRA so we can track audit.

owen: noted. I'll create INFRA-4621 and link PR here in ~10m. Will tag `temp-egress` and schedule automated revoke at +24h.

maya: one more: if partner can expose VPCE or a proxy, prefer that long term. If they refuse, proceed with the temp allowlist flow. Thanks.

owen: thanks all — will update thread with JIRA/PR links. :alarm_clock:
